title: Comparison Between the Analgesic Efficacy of Erector Spinae Plane Block and Psoas Compartment Block in Hip Surgery
brief_summary: To evaluate the ability of Erector spina Plane block and Psoas compartment block to decrease postoperative pain and analgesia requirements in patients undergoing hip surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

ASA (American Society of Anesthesiologists) I- ASA II Patients

\-

Exclusion Criteria:

* history of allergy to the study medication
* refusal to participate
